verdict.rationale: Trello documents a native integration layer: Power-Ups that link teams' favorite tools, an app directory, and Slack capture into the Trello Inbox, plus a Jira list Power-Up. However, the evidence never names GitHub or Google Drive integrations, and one community report cites add-on restrictions for solo users. Missing for 10: documented native GitHub integration, documented native Google Drive integration, depth of the Slack integration beyond Inbox capture, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Capture every vital detail from emails, Slack, and more directly into your Trello Inbox.
